bio.text: William J. Carson Jr. has represented District 28 in the Delaware House of Representatives since being elected in 2007; the district includes portions of Smyrna, Leipsic, Little Creek and Dover.
He is a lifelong resident of Smyrna, graduated from Smyrna High School, and retired from the Town of Middletown and the Delaware Department of Transportation.
Carson is a veteran of the Delaware Air National Guard and chairs the House Appropriations and Agriculture committees and co-chairs the Joint Finance Committee.
